page.layout: One printed page. Top: title block centred (widely spaced capitals, italic and roman lines, a Greek line). Below it: a Greek motto line centred. Then a decorated woodcut initial D with the text wrapped to its right, running down to the foot of the page. Digitiser watermark at bottom right, not transcribed.

main_text.head: UT ET Prænobili, Amplissimo ac Consul-tissimo VIRO, D. JOHANNI DE BEJER, J. U. D. Consilii Sta-tus Directori.
main_text.p: Uo capita, Viri Generosi ac Prænobiles, potissimum (sunt enim & alia) à vobis in tabulas accepti mihi relata sunt, quæ me movent & cogunt exiguam hanc opellam Generosis ac Prænobilibus Vestris nominibus inscribere. Primum mihi cum Clarissimis meis Collegis est commune, alterum ad officium meum privatum pertinet. Gratitudo primum jubet prædicare vestrum favorem erga lyceum

page.notes: The large woodcut initial is a D, joined to the first word as "Duo" in the scan; the printed first word reads "Uo" with the initial D set in the woodcut panel, so it is given here as printed with the initial D in the cut. The Greek motto line is printed as it appears and may contain scan errors. Stains and show-through omitted.
